text: {"assertions":["A race condition in lazy initialization of key rotation caused signature verification mismatches, particularly affecting jobs scheduled across midnight boundaries.","The root cause was a verification failure when requests were in flight during signing key rotation.","The fix involved implementing a double-checked lock pattern to guard the initialization in crypto/keys/rotation.py.","The solution was implemented in PR #1032 on the fix/signature-mismatch-1 branch.","Test coverage for the key rotation fix is located in tests/crypto/test_rotation.py.","The error rate was reduced from 2.1% to under 0.02% (2 per 10,000) after the fix was applied."]}
